dataSource.name: Q_MAIN
dataSource.select: SELECT emp_id, name, salary FROM employees WHERE dept_id = :P_DEPT_ID

dataSource.name: Q_HIST
dataSource.select: SELECT emp_id, old_salary, new_salary FROM salary_hist WHERE changed_at BETWEEN :P_DATE_FROM AND :P_DATE_TO

function.name: CF_TOTAL_SALARY
function.textSource: function CF_TOTAL_SALARY return number is v number; begin select sum(salary) into v from employees; return v; end;
